name: engineering-methodology
description: Three-stage AI-assisted feature methodology — Concept Note, Spec, Implementation Plan — with the staged-engineering-doc skill that produces or derives any of the three documents through guided Q&A and codebase research, the three-p-visualizer skill that renders them as an interactive Product / Process / Project HTML explainer (abstraction ladder, NFR lenses, pipeline, risk matrix), the spec-answers skill that answers questions about a documented feature from its Concept Note and Spec with cited IDs and an explicit answer status, and the spec-conformance skill that audits the codebase against the Spec — forward (every obligation → file:line evidence at a pinned commit, one verdict each) and backward (code behaviour no ID sanctions).
